from flask import request, jsonify

def paginated_query(query):
    page = max(1, request.args.get('page', 1, type=int))
    per_page = min(100, request.args.get('per_page', 20, type=int))
    p = query.paginate(page=page, per_page=per_page, error_out=False)
    return jsonify({
        'data': [i.to_dict() if hasattr(i, 'to_dict') else str(i) for i in p.items],
        'page': p.page,
        'per_page': p.per_page,
        'total': p.total,
        'pages': p.pages
    })
